directions: Suppose the university newspaper is inwiting submissions from the students for its coming edition on how the students can contribule lo a green campus. You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minules lo wrile the essay.You should write at least120wordsbutnomorethan180words.
sample_essay:
Creating a green campus is not only beneficial for the environment but also for the well-being of all students. As students, we can play a significant role in contributing to a green campus.

To begin with, we can conserve energy. For example, we should turn off lights, fans, and other electrical appliances when leaving the classroom or dormitory. This simple act can save a large amount of electricity, which is a precious resource. In addition, we can reduce waste. Instead of using disposable products like plastic bags and chopsticks, we can bring our own reusable ones. This will cut down on the amount of waste that goes into landfills.

Furthermore, we can plant more trees and flowers on campus. Trees can absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen, improving the air quality. We can also participate in campus environmental protection activities organized by the school, such as cleaning up litter in the campus.

In conclusion, every student can make a difference in creating a green campus. By conserving energy, reducing waste, and planting greenery, we can build a more sustainable and beautiful campus.
